# QR Code generator

`qrcodegen.py` is the unmodified Python implementation from Project Nayuki,
version 1.8.0, distributed under the MIT license included in its header.

Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/v1.8.0/python/qrcodegen.py

Vendored to generate QR matrices locally without a remote QR service or an
additional pip/npm installation. CampaignService renders a SVG with a four-module
quiet zone. No campaign or visitor data is sent to the upstream project.
